name: W-TinyLFU
summary: Approximate frequencies in a four-bit sketch decide admission, so an unpopular newcomer never displaces a proven entry.

source.title: TinyLFU: A Highly Efficient Cache Admission Policy

params.name: windowFraction
params.description: Fraction of capacity given to the admission window.

params.name: protectedFraction
params.description: Fraction of the main cache reserved for protected entries.

notes: Keys must be integers: the sketch hashes them directly.
